title: Zelensky Approves 40-Day SSU Operation to Pressure Russia Toward War's End
detail: President Zelensky approved a 40-day Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) operation designed to exert pressure on Russia and compel it to end the war. The operation reflects Ukraine's shift toward coercive intelligence-led strategies as a complement to battlefield pressure and diplomatic isolation.

title: European Council Extends Russia Sanctions Through Summer 2027
detail: The European Council formally extended its sanctions regime against Russia through summer 2027, signaling continued Western resolve to maintain economic pressure on Moscow. The extension keeps in place measures targeting Russian energy, finance, and defense sectors introduced following the 2022 invasion.
